        "text": "SHIPPED (PR #316, merged into main).\n\nRoot cause found by arithmetic, then verified by measurement: Move() thrusts at full acceleration along the steer ANGLE, so a ship pulled at a point beside its track settles into a circular orbit of radius ShipMaxSpeed^2/ShipAcceleration = 36.3px - OUTSIDE the 15px arrive-deadzone - and circles its own station at full thrust forever. Neither documented revert (velocity-damped arrive; wider deadzone) covers this case.\n\nFix: an ORBIT BRAKE on the seek only - within 2x the orbit radius (72.6px, DERIVED from the motion constants, not tuned) the seek direction gains a retro-tangential term scaled by sideways speed, so a fly-past sheds orbital velocity and falls into the deadzone. Radial approach/escape and all repellents untouched (what got the arrive reverted). New seam ?aiorbitbrake= (0 = pre-card arm); DebugFlags rejection case + ProbeAiFlagRejection row + web CLAUDE.md bullet included.\n\nMeasured (ai_sweep seeds 1-8 x2, brake vs 0): turn/revs down on all three rigs (level1 164 vs 186 deg/s, 3.27 vs 3.52 revs; ownlevel 720 vs 750; crazygame 673 vs 712), idle% DOWN (10.1 vs 11.4 level1 - the guard), deaths within 1 SEM everywhere, level1 pickups 90.1 vs 85.5%.\n\nVerified: clean build, logic_probe ALL PASS (incl. new flag row).\nNEEDS: N=60 jitter/idle/deaths sweep in the orchbench scoring pass.",
